name: HyperSwap 1c_256.onnx (FaceFusion models-3.3.0)
notes: Drop-in replacement for inswapper_128.onnx in ReActor. Operates at 256x256 (vs 128x128), same InsightFace ArcFace pipeline. ReActor >=0.6.2 supports it; place in ComfyUI/models/hyperswap. ~2 GB VRAM. HF mirror uploaded Jul 29 2026; underlying model from facefusion/models-3.3.0 (Jun 2025).

name: Lucida — BiRefNet-HR fine-tune (egeorcun/lucida)
notes: HF last updated Jul 24 2026. 220.7M params, MIT. Purpose-built for transparent objects, glass, camouflage, VFX glow, illustrations. MAE 0.0257 vs RMBG-2.0 at 0.0401 overall. RMBG-2.0 still leads on hair. Drop-in checkpoint in build_rembg_birefnet; expose as named variant. Already integrated in ComfyUI-RMBG v3.1.0.

name: ComfyUI-RMBG v3.1.0
notes: Released Jul 21 2026. Adds Lucida to BiRefNet model selector and per-node alpha sensitivity parameter. Also exposes BEN2 (v1.7.0), SAM2 segmentation (v2.8.0), SDMatte matting (v2.9.0) added in earlier 2025 sub-releases.

name: SAM 3.1 — Object Multiplex checkpoints (facebookresearch/sam3)
notes: Released Mar 27 2026. Object Multiplex: shared-memory joint tracking of multiple objects, ~2x video throughput. 848M params. Drop-in checkpoint for build_sam3_segment, build_sam3_mask, build_sam3_extract — no code changes. BLOCKER: HF access is gated (Meta approval required). Applies equally to build_sam3_mask and build_sam3_extract.

name: SAM 3.1 — Object Multiplex (same as above, applies to build_sam3_mask)
notes: See build_sam3_segment entry. Identical upgrade path.

name: SAM 3.1 — Object Multiplex (same as above, applies to build_sam3_extract)
notes: See build_sam3_segment entry. Identical upgrade path.

name: Depth Anything 3 (ByteDance-Seed/depth-anything-3)
notes: Nov 2025 (ByteDance-Seed). Multi-view consistency, monocular metric depth (DA3Metric-Large), pose estimation, 3D Gaussian output. ComfyUI-DepthAnythingV3 wrapper stable. DA3-Streaming <12 GB VRAM for ultra-long video. Variants: Giant/Large/Base/Small + Metric + Mono Large. Clear upgrade for build_depth_map_v3. First-run finding — not tracked in prior research.

name: LTX-2.3 (Lightricks/LTX-2, 22B)
notes: HF last updated Jul 9 2026. 9.9M downloads, 1738 likes. Spatial and temporal upscalers built in. Fits 16 GB with sequential offload. Tier 1 if build_ltx_video is still on legacy 8B LTX-Video base — this upgrade is overdue. First-run finding.

name: Microsoft Mage-Flow 4B (Comfy-Org/Mage-Flow)
notes: MIT licensed. GenEval 0.90 — highest open-source T2I. ComfyUI native support v0.29.0 (Jul 29). Ships as Base, RL (post-trained), Turbo (4-step). Variants: bf16, fp8, int8_convrot. Use int8_convrot for 16 GB headroom (~9 GB peak). Text encoder: Qwen3-VL 4B. Needs new builder: build_mageflow_txt2img + build_mageflow_edit. Not a drop-in for SDXL/Flux.

name: Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo (Comfy-Org/Mage-Flow)
notes: Image + text instruction editing variant of Mage-Flow. Direct additive competitor to build_qwen_edit (different text encoder/architecture). Int8 variant for 16 GB. Add as build_mageflow_edit alongside build_qwen_edit rather than replacing it. See Mage-Flow txt2img entry for loader details.

name: JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus (jdopensource, 8B MLLM + 16B MMDiT)
notes: Apache 2.0. Unique: accepts 1-6 reference images alongside text instruction for multi-reference synthesis (absent from build_qwen_edit). Native ComfyUI v0.29.0 (Jul 29). INT8 diffusion is 16.4 GB on disk — very tight on 16 GB. Recommend GGUF Q4_K_M from vantagewithai/JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus-ComfyUI-GGUF. New builder: build_joyai_edit.

name: NVIDIA PiD v1.5 (optional VAE decode path for Flux/Klein/Qwen)
notes: Drop-in VAE decoder replacement for Flux, Klein/Flux2, and Qwen-Image pipelines. Single-step conditional pixel diffusion → 2K/4K output. v1.5 (Jul 9) improves color fidelity and fixes corner artifacts. ComfyUI native (v0.28.0 Jul 15) + community node github.com/Merserk/ComfyUI-PiD. ~2-3 GB VRAM during decode only. Applies to: build_txt2img, build_img2img, build_inpaint, build_outpaint, all build_klein_*, build_qwen_edit.

name: Krea 2 Identity Edit LoRA v1.2 (conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit)
notes: Updated Jul 29 2026. Instruction-based identity-preserving editing for Krea-2-Raw/Turbo. v1.2 adds face/head/eye/person swap via plain-text instructions. ComfyUI node: lbouaraba/comfyui-krea2edit. FP8 ~12 GB VRAM. BF16 ~28 GB (skip). Natural boundary blending; softer likeness than ReActor. LICENSE: non-commercial only — confirm with user before wiring. New builder: build_krea_identity.

name: PMRF Blind Face Image Restoration (fsxedx/PMRF_blind_face_image_restoration)
notes: ICLR 2025 paper. 230.5M params, MIT, safetensors. Fork uploaded Jul 27 2026. ~3.3 GB VRAM, ~1 s/image. ComfyUI-PMRF node (2kpr/ComfyUI-PMRF) exists. Does not replace CodeFormer's fidelity-dial; use as fast low-VRAM first-pass or fallback in build_face_restore / build_photo_restore.

name: MiniMax H3 / Hailuo 3.0 (API partner node; open weights imminent)
notes: Released Jul 30-31 2026. T2V, I2V, first/last-frame, 9-image/3-clip/3-audio multimodal input. Native 2K at 24 fps, 5-15 s, synchronized audio. API partner node in ComfyUI v0.29.2. Open weights 'coming within days' per MiniMax — not on HF as of Aug 1. VRAM unknown for local weights. Do not wire until weights ship and VRAM confirmed <=16 GB. New builder: build_minimax_h3_video.

name: ComfyUI-Trellis2 + TRELLIS.2-4B (microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B)
notes: 4B params, MIT, Dec 2025. Sharper geometry + better PBR materials than Hunyuan3D-2. Jul 31 2026 update adds PyMeshlab smoothing post-processing nodes. Official minimum 16 GB with sequential offload — matches budget exactly. Test on hardware before wiring. New builder alongside existing HunyuanDiT3D methods.

name: SeedVR2 native ComfyUI core (v0.28.0, Jul 15 2026)
notes: ComfyUI v0.28.0 (Jul 15) promoted SeedVR2 image and video upscaling to core — external custom node dependency can be dropped. RTX 50-series path also delivers 2.5x faster generation and 60% lower VRAM. SeedVR2 itself has no new checkpoint (GGUF Q4/Q8 path from Nov 2025 supports 8 GB VRAM).

name: FLUX 3 (Black Forest Labs, closed early-access)
notes: Announced Jul 25 2026. Multimodal single-backbone: image, 20-second video with audio, robot action-prediction. Self-Flow training. No open weights. BFL committed to FLUX 3 Dev open-weight release later in 2026 — will supersede Flux1-dev and potentially Klein/Flux2 when available. Monitor BFL HuggingFace org.

name: Wan 2.7 (Alibaba, API-only partner node)
notes: Wan 2.7 adds reasoning step before generation, T2V/I2V/audio. API-partner-node only; open weights stop at WAN 2.2. If Alibaba releases Wan 2.7 weights it would be Tier 1 for build_wan22_t2v. Monitor Alibaba open-weight release.

name: Anima Turbo v1.0 + Aesthetic v1.0 (CircleStone Labs)
notes: 2B anime/illustration DiT fine-tuned from NVIDIA Cosmos-Predict2-2B-Text2Image. ~6 GB VRAM. ComfyUI-lite ControlNet support added v0.29.0. Anime niche only; not relevant to current photoreal Spellcaster workflows.

name: Seedream 5.0 Pro Partner Node (ByteDance)
notes: Cloud API-only (Volcano Engine / BytePlus key required). Deep-thinking prompt reasoning, live web-search grounding, point/lasso/sketch/color/material precision editing, multilingual in-image text, native 2K, transparent layer export. Zero VRAM (server-side). Not suitable for offline Spellcaster workflows.

name: FaceFusion 3.8.0 (infrastructure release, Jul 31 2026)
notes: Pure infrastructure: FFmpeg video manager, AV1 codec, HDR alpha, disk/memory workflow-strategy. No new ONNX model pack (facefusion/models-3.8.0 does not exist yet; latest is 3.6.0 from Mar 2026). Monitor for models-3.8.0/3.9.0 ONNX drop — FaceFusion Labs typically releases new swapper model alongside major feature releases.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video — Bernini-R IC-LoRA (ByteDance)
notes: IC-LoRA for ByteDance/Bernini-R video model enabling video face/head swap. Apache 2.0 open-weight model. Bernini-R BF16 estimated ~24 GB VRAM — exceeds RTX 5060 Ti budget. Promote to Tier 2 if INT4/INT8 Bernini-R appears. Community forks created Jul 9-19 2026.

name: ComfyUI-Forbidden-Vision (Jul 19 2026 update)
notes: Custom-trained YOLO11 + segmentation + neural color corrector for face detection/enhancement. Positions as Impact Pack FaceDetailer / ADetailer replacement. Handles extreme poses, occlusion, anime and realistic. Updated Jul 19 (6 days before window). Potentially useful as alternative detection backbone upstream of build_klein_face_detail. Not a new swapper or restoration model.

name: NTIRE 2026 Real-World Face Restoration Challenge winners (Apr 2026)
notes: CVPR 2026 Workshop. One-step/distilled diffusion priors with semantic guidance — architecturally more capable than CodeFormer at blind restoration. Paper arxiv:2604.10532. No ComfyUI wrapper yet for winning methods. Research frontier; revisit when wrapper appears.

name: BiRefNet ToonOut — anime background removal (Jul 21 2026)
notes: Fine-tuned on 1,228 curated anime images. Pixel accuracy 99.5% on anime/illustration test sets vs 95.3% for generic BiRefNet. MIT. No benefit on photorealistic inputs. Monitor only unless Spellcaster targets anime workflows.

name: Hi3D V3.0 (announced Jul 30, Aug 2026 launch)
notes: Claims 2048^3 voxel resolution, 8K texture output, upgraded UV completion. Closed commercial platform (Math Magic) — no open-source weights indicated. ComfyUI integration would require API wrapper. Monitor after release for weight availability.

name: LTX-2.3 distillation LoRAs (joeygambino/ltx23-videoonly-distill-loras)
notes: Created Jul 30 2026. 1 like, 0 downloads. Training recipe unverified. Incompatible with legacy 8B LTX-Video base — requires LTX-2.3 checkpoint. Evaluate manually before wiring.

name: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 (Jul 31 2026)
notes: SKIP. Fully proprietary/API-only via Jimeng/CapCut/Volcano Engine. Single-shot 30 s video, 4K, 50-source multimodal reference. No open weights, no local deployment path.

name: ComfyUI v0.29.0 video transcode streaming (Jul 29 2026)
notes: Infrastructure: frames streamed rather than fully buffered in RAM; reduces peak-RAM ~1-2 GB for all build_*_video methods. Also: Image Processing Node gains video I/O support; new Trainer video nodes. Upgrade ComfyUI to >=0.29.0 to benefit. Not a model upgrade.
